ruleDefinitions.name: Run Once Task Execution as Configured in Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detects the execution of Run Once task as configured in the registry

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\runonce\\\.exe$") OR process_description = "Run\ Once\ Wrapper") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/AlternateShellStartup.*") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/r$")))
